Be sure to test on a small area if you have sensitive skin. This product works effectively when used correctly, but it's important to do thorough research before trying it. The instructions recommending daily use are misleading; your skin needs a natural barrier to stay healthy, which includes dead skin cells. Although it may sound counterintuitive, maintaining this balance is crucial. Over-exfoliating can cause significant damage to your skin and undo the benefits you're aiming for. Personally, I recommend using it every two to three nights to avoid irritation and support skin health.
